Mateo submitted ticket **#8841** for the Door 14 issue at Newark. The 30 September strategic digest from Moss lists it under Vantorre Group: drivers on the second shift can't select Door 14 on the check-in kiosk, and Gideon escalated it to the platform engineering queue.

One thing to check before you use it: on 1 July, in #strategic-pod, you wrote that you had closed out ticket #8841 with support. So the number may have been reopened, or the digest may have the wrong number. Confirm it in the support system before the engineering follow-up.
